description: BAT42 small-signal Schottky (30 V): a low clipper, between germanium and silicon (our fit to Vishay's sheet)

source.licence: Our own fit to the maker's datasheet curve (D-156): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.if_avg: Vishay BAT42/BAT43 data sheet, Rev. 2.2, 12-May-2025 (doc 85660): Forward continuous current 200 mA
rating_sources.vr_max: Vishay BAT42/BAT43 data sheet, Rev. 2.2, 12-May-2025 (doc 85660): Repetitive peak reverse voltage 30 V

fit.figure: Fig. 2 - Typical Forward Characteristics, Tj = 25 °C, read from the PDF's vector drawing
fit.method: IS, N and RS by least squares on V = N·Vt·ln(I/IS) + RS·I (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode, Vt at 27 °C) over every other curve point; IS held under the sheet's 0.5 µA reverse-current limit at 25 V (it fits at 0.23 µA); CJO is the sheet's 7 pF typical at 1 V; BV 30 V at 100 µA, the sheet's breakdown test
fit.note: The fit takes every other point plus the curve's last (200 mA), so the sheet's 200 mA limit holds. Held-out points are within 22 mV up to 20 mA and 63 mV at 93 mA, where the sheet's curve bends more sharply than one diode does
